programme.title: Newscast
programme.desc: Join BBC journalists including political editor Laura Kuenssberg, Europe editor Katya Adler, Brussels correspondent Adam Fleming and political correspondent Chris Mason in their weekly podcast discussing all of the news stories that matter to the people of the United Kingdom. The journalists know all about the stories that they're talking about - they interview the most important people involved in the stories that feature in the news. They speak of their knowledge and understanding of the news in a way that is understandable for all. Laura is often in a car in the middle of a city where big politics stories are happening. Katya, Adam and Chris are usually in the studio. They regularly talk about Brexit and what is going to happen when the United Kingdom leaves the European Union.

programme.title: BBC News
programme.desc: The latest news from the BBC,which is designed to inform you on current affairs. The BBC is aims to be a totally impartial public service broadcaster, and was established by Royal Charter. The BBC is funded by a licence fee paid by British households, and is regulated by Ofcom. They aim to create high-quality content, in order to inform and educate, but also entertain, their audience Millions of people from all over the world watch content produced by the BBC, and they are well respected as a media company. It was founded in 1922, with its headquarters in Westminster, London.

programme.title: Talking Business
programme.desc: On Talking Business BBC presenters, based in the world's most dynamic cities, discuss with the most important and influential people from the world of business and finance, the key issues of the day. Corporate leaders, global investors, top creatives, cutting-edge entrepreneurs and leading intellectuals gather together weekly to discuss and analyse the issues and trends that most affect how business has to work in today's world. Our team of presenters are experts on the issues and developments which are shaping the way we work, consume and live in the 21st Century.

programme.title: Newsday
programme.desc: "Good Morning Asia, hello World." Join the news teams from BBC World News in London and Singapore. This live news and current affairs program is broadcast globally and focuses on all the latest news and breaking developing stories that matter around the world. The show is usually presented by Rico Hizon in Singapore and Kasia Madera in London. Broadcasting live at midnight GMT on both BBC World News and the BBC News channel, the show is broadcast in the morning in Asia and therefore is marketed as a morning show for people watching around the country. The show is often followed by Asia Business Report live from Singapore which reports on all the latest economy and business figures from the country.

programme.title: BBC World News America
programme.desc: News presenter Katty Kay keeps you up to date with all the latest breaking news from America and the rest of the world on BBC World News America. This world renowned news and current affairs program has been recognised for its exceptional reporting at the Emmy Awards. BBC World News America won two Emmy awards for its coverage of the conflicts in Syria and the Central African Republic. You can catch up with this award winning broadcast team as they air multiple times a day throughout the week.

programme.title: Newsnight
programme.desc: In-depth news and current affairs review of the main political and economic stories of the day, featuring robust interviews with senior government and opposition figures, business and union leaders, and analytical reports that delve behind the headlines. Regular presenters cross-examine studio guests on details of policies, priorities, actions and inactions, on a range of domestic UK and international topics. There are weekly features on the arts, sports and the world of technology, and editors are not afraid to venture into niche, specialist and exotic areas from space travel to animal psychology. If the BBC's flagship Radio 4 Today programme sets the early morning news agenda for the day, then its late-night TV equivalent often gives the people in power some sleepless nights.

programme.desc: Join our hosts, renowned celebrity chefs and restaurateurs Bobby Flay and Michael Symon, as they test the skills of eight expert barbecue connoisseurs. Filmed at the Star Hill Ranch in Austin, Texas, the eight chefs are divided into two teams but, in order to claim first pick for their team, Bobby and Michael go head-to-head in a backyard BBQ challenge. Each episode sees one of the chefs being eliminated from the show until there is only one left, the winner who is awarded the title of 'Master of Cue'. The weekly contests aim to reveal the chefs' talents and expose their weaknesses and include tasks such as cooking up a tomahawk rib-eye and taking on a Texas beef challenge.

programme.title: Chef Grudge Match

The winners walk out with $10,000 cash, a prized knife from the losing chef's knife roll and bragging rights for life!

programme.title: Summer Baking Championship

She finishes up with the coolest party dish -- her Smorgastarta that combines salmon salad and egg salad sandwiches in cake form!

programme.title: Girl Meets Farm

A former big city girl, Yeh is multi talented, a successful blogger and classically trained musician, its food that ultimately stole her heart. Learn lots of tricks and tips with Yeh as she cooks up her personal favourite recipes for every occasion, from family visits to brunch with the girls to a classic farm supper! This show is an absolute treat.

programme.desc: After combating countless "impossible dinners," Chef Robert Irvine faces a daunting new challenge: save America's most desperate restaurants from impending failure in just two days with only $10,000. In his new prime-time Food Network series, Restaurant: Impossible, Robert uses creativity and resourcefulness along with a lot of muscle in his fight to rescue these restaurants and give hope to the owners and their employees. Day one of the extreme mission begins with a thorough business assessment as Robert launches the restaurant into full service, closely observes the staff and kitchen, and determines their weakest spots. Then, he springs into action by updating the menu, retraining the staff and implementing aesthetic changes with the help of his design team. To ensure a packed house for the grand re-opening at the end of day two, Robert hits the streets to tell the community about the improved restaurant. Will the ruthless schedule, tight budget and ambitious task overcome Robert's lofty goals, or will this tall order result in restaurant triumph?

programme.title: Ghost Loop
programme.desc: Follow a team of highly specialized paranormal experts, who help both the living and the dead and focus on a distinct type of haunting - ''ghost loop'', which happens when paranormal entities terrorize the living through endless and repetitive supernatural cycles, manifesting again and again in the same location. In each episode, paranormal investigator and medium Sean Austin, empath Kris Star, researcher and tech advisor Chris Califf, design specialist Eric Vitale, and tech support Matt Lytle, examine and research their client's property and history. Then, they formulate a plan they believe will help stop the haunting - whether it's building a 1900s-era train compartment, replicating a tavern from the 1850s, or constructing a 19th century baby's nursery. The team uses emotionally charged settings to draw out the entities in hopes that it will release the energy and break the loop once and for all.

programme.title: The Haunted Museum
programme.desc: Follow the frightening and hellish tales behind the spooky relics on display in Zak Bagans' Las Vegas museum, by way of scripted shorts produced by Roth and his accredited team, and with featured commentary from Bagans himself.

programme.title: Ghost Adventures
programme.desc: Paranormal documentary and reality TV series follows investigations of scary locations reported to be haunted by ghost hunters Zak Bagans, Nick Groff, and Aaron Goodwin. Many places with shady past like hotels, casinos, homes, abandoned buildings are full of aggressive paranormal activities and do not let people live peacefully. Each episode begins with the crew touring the investigation site with its owners and interviewing the witnesses. Then the ghost hunters crew set up static night-vision cameras to film what's happening. They use a lot of up-to-date equipment to get any sort of evidence and then based on what they manage to get, they start analyzing and investigating things in order to get to the core of each case.

programme.title: Paranormal Lockdown
programme.desc: Paranormal Lockdown brings together Nick Groff from Ghost Adventures and Katrina Weidmann from Paranormal State as they spend 72 hours completely locked down in some of the most haunted places in America. Believing that by spending time isolated within a haunted location for a longer period of time than most paranormal shows will bring them closer to communication with the spirits that may be haunting these locations.

programme.title: NASA's Unexplained Files
programme.desc: What do we really know about life beyond the realm of our planet? Disturbing discoveries about the rest of our universe have perplexed scientists, and the rest of the world, for as long as we can remember. Now, the files and discoveries of one of the worlds biggest independent agencies have been dug up, for thorough investigation. Each episode scrutinises questionable evidence, encounters and sightings, to shed some light on the unexplained files of NASA. Featuring testimonies of NASA insiders and scientists who have first hand experience of the enigmas, laying within our universe.

programme.title: Ice Cold Gold
programme.desc: While Josh, Chad and John are down at base camp prepping the dredge to move to the upper lake, Eric and the Red Zone team are pulling out rubies by the scores, but it's a hard-won success. With food supplies almost nonexistent and weather turning from bad to worse on a dime, the team is mustering all its strength to make this venture a success. John desperately wants to see the rubies on his 50th birthday, so he makes a foolhardy hike to the Red Zone with more than 50 pounds of reindeer meat on his back. It's a dangerous trek never before done by any human, and with the wrong intentions, he puts the team at severe risk with his choice to redeem himself. Meanwhile, Eric gets a bad case of ruby fever and successfully ventures farther and deeper into the Red Zone. The miners find a deposit a hundred times better than their first and confirm they could be sitting at the epicenter of the largest ruby band in the world. They find one particular ruby worth $200,000, but with ruby fever in full swing, the team members begin to mistrust themselves and each other. Eric tries to take control but ends up breaking the ruby that could have paid for the whole season. The group's low morale is saved when John arrives with reindeer meat, but time and weather are forcing them to leave the Red Zone in two days. In the mad rush to take care of business, the team begins to unravel again, and adding John into the mix only stirs the pot worse.

programme.title: Ice Cold Gold
programme.desc: ICE COLD GOLD spotlights a spirited team of miners who are among the first Americans to prospect for precious metals and gems in parts of Greenland where humans never have set foot before. The six-part series follows eight men who leave behind their families, friends and homeland to strike it rich against all odds while struggling to survive against the harshest of conditions. Greenland's a veritable beast, but the motley crew of ICE COLD GOLD miners is up for the challenge. Each thinks he has what it takes to walk away with gold, rubies and sapphires before winter and large mining companies swoop in. What transpires as the miners cope with the unpredictable, harsh unknown? Are they humbled by their journey? Do their personalities get in the way? Most importantly, do they strike ICE COLD GOLD?ed ice sheets.

programme.title: Mysteries At The Museum
programme.desc: Documentary series in which host Don Wildman, history enthusiast and adventurer, focuses on interesting and unusual artifacts held in museums, historical institutions, and unexplored archives around the world. Don discovers extraordinary, obscure relics and artifacts, shares their incredible stories, that have either been forgotten or are lesser known, and reveals their secrets, taking the viewers on a spectacular tour through history. We also get to find out why and how some of these unusual objects ended up in the museums.

It's an isolated outlaw town - a refuge for people who don't want to be found that's surrounded by extreme wilderness over 100 miles from the authorities where young men go to prove themselves and old outlaws go to die; hunters, gold miners, gunsmiths, and survivalists who reside in this 'Old West' town are willing to risk their lives to live truly free. While some believe in continuing the town's frontier way of life, others feel the future of McCarthy depends on dragging itself into the modern age. Which way of life will reign supreme?

programme.desc: From small towns in the South to remote areas of the Pacific Northwest and Alaska, four eccentric but passionate members of the Bigfoot Field Researchers Organization (BFRO) embark on one single-minded mission: to find the elusive "creature" known as Bigfoot or the Sasquatch. The team consists of Bigfoot Field Researchers Organization (BFRO) founder and President Matt Moneymaker, researchers James "Bobo" Fay and Cliff Barackman and skeptical scientist Ranae Holland. The series never questions the existence of Bigfoot, but rather documents the team's search efforts and study of evidence in an attempt to prove the existence of the elusive creature.

Their main goal is to prove that mysterious creatures like Bigfoot, Werewolf, Hellhound, Lizard Man, and Mothman do exist and provide the proper evidence to the viewers.

Using their Sourthern charm and engineering knowledge to create supernatural inventions during their hunting to find ghosts or spirits of any kind. Their speciality is investigating the decaying, haunting and skin crawling mental institutions throughout the USA, warning viewers that they have permission to enter the most haunted buildings and that chasing ghosts without proper training "will get you killed", so don't try this at home.

This series sees Maria seeking truths about crimes committed on US soil, finding the evidence to overturn wrongful convictions, uncovering the clues to prosecute murderers and helping families find closure.

programme.title: Fatal Destination
programme.desc: A teenager's spring break getaway to Myrtle Beach turns into a mystery that grips the nation; sneaking off without her parents' permission, she vanishes into the night, leaving behind a trail of cryptic clues.

programme.title: Reasonable Doubt
programme.desc: As we all know, the initial verdict in a trial is not always the final outcome as many trial jury decisions are often overturned on appeal. However, the appeals process can take a significant amount of time to go through the system and also incur enormous costs on the individuals involved. This show follows the work of two investigators who re-examine the verdicts in contentious murder cases and assess the prospects of a successful appeal for the families of the people convicted of the crimes to determine if they should appeal or accept the verdict. Each episode traces the developments in the case, whether it be new evidence or witness testimony, which can then shed light on the innocence of the convicted person or show that, indeed, they are guilty of the crime and the verdict was correct.

programme.title: Murder In the Heartland
programme.desc: This series focuses on the dark underbelly of the American mid-west, its heartland. Each episode deals with a specific murder that's been commited in one of the small towns that make up this iconic region of the US with the locals enhancing the tales and bringing clues to our attention. The show includes interviews with the victim's family, friends, law enforcement officers and also provides dramatic reenactments to bring the stories to life. Episodes reveal true stories such as when an Oklahoma family's dog drops a human skull onto their porch and the police are called in to investigate; a bride-to-be who discovers her betrothed shot in the head in their living room; a beloved father, son and fiancee who is discovered beaten to death in his own driveway; and a devoted family man who diappears after his truck is set on fire.

Although they all knew each other and their bodies were discovered in very similar circumstances, local police refuse to link the deaths. While some residents think the murders could be the work of a serial killer, others believe a darker conspiracy is at work and it may even include members of law enforcement. As they wait in vain for the investigation to move forward, the victim's families refuse to give up in their quest for justice. But with the investigation into all 8 deaths still open, police aren't talking, leaving the community haunted by the question: who killed the Jennings 8?

programme.title: The Lake Erie Murders
programme.desc: Coming from the beautiful environs of Lake Erie, straddling the border between the US and Canada, this true life crime show focuses on the more sinister and gruesome tales of some of the region's darkest and deadliest crimes. We explore baffling and mysterious murder cases such as that of the 1989 kidnapping and murder of 10-year-old Amy Mihaljevic which provoked much speculation and intrigue in the area and which is still an open case. Each hourlong episode delves into the case history, analyzes the facts and evidence and carefully examines the detection procedures and how each suspect was cleared of suspicion. programme.desc: American Chopper is an American reality television series that revolves around the Teutuls- Paul Senior, his sons Paul Junior and Michael who work together at Orange County Choppers, a custom motorcycle fabrication company located in Montgomery, New York. The series is a mix of competition and drama, famous for real fighting, cursing, crying, welding, and painting. It's indisputable that each Teutul is a gifted mechanic, engineer and designer, they put together a motorbike in front of the viewers and make every customer's wish come true.

programme.title: Naked and Afraid: Global Showdown
programme.desc: Cracking Under The Pressure. The survivalists' primitive bows are tested. Underdogs dominate the challenge, rocking the competition. Another legend is sent to elimination.

programme.title: Street Outlaws
programme.desc: Reality series focuses on the amazing opportunity to dive into American street racing world. Look at how need for speed unites people and find out what adrenaline addicts are ready for in Oklahoma, unofficial capital of illegal street racing. Only top racers participate in the competition, they want to appear and stay at the A-list, everything they have to do is to try to squeeze as much performance out of their vehicles as possible.

programme.title: Salvage Hunters
programme.desc: Drew Pritchard is a modern-day treasure hunter searching the back roads of the UK to discover hidden riches. With demanding customers, high turnover and one of the biggest decorative salvage yards in the UK, Drew is constantly on the road, crisscrossing the country in search of derelict gems and forgotten remnants. Drew loves the thrill of the hunt and while he gets his hands dirty in the country's architectural backwaters, his crack team of restorers is back at the shop giving old and rare finds a new lease on life. Follow Drew and his crack team of specialists on a fascinating journey through the entire picking process – from the initial expedition, to renewal, and finally to resale. Showcasing his hard-earned knowledge and appreciation of salvage and restoration, each episode accompanies Drew on one big buying venture, such as setting off with an empty van and returning with a 20th century stained glass Gothic doorway from an Irish monastery – as well as the small, unpredictable adventures along the way. Simply discovering a treasure is only half the battle, as Drew must artfully convince owners to sell, and at his price. After a successful purchase, Drew and his team of experts bring the items back to Fabulously British Salvage, his tremendous 20,000 square foot showroom located in North Wales, to restore them to their original brilliance, before reselling them for profit. This is not an easy business, as any trip can feature the next great find or a bust that costs Drew and his team thousands. However, Drew's keen eye and adroit negotiating skills are second to none – his passion and drive for success make him one of the best in the business.

programme.title: Wheeler Dealers
programme.desc: Buy, repair and restore and then resell a classic car in order to make profit- this is what Wheeler Dealers is about. The budget is limited, though you can see some exclusive and rare cars. Mike Brewer, a British dealer chooses the car carefully and hands it over to the mechanic, first Edd China, later Ant Anstead to be fixed and upgraded. The hosts are real masters of their trade, it seems they can bring life even to a piece of metal. It does not matter if you are a life-long car enthusiast or do not even have a driving license you will admire the results of hard work from the beginning to the end of the long uneasy restoring process.

programme.title: How It's Made
programme.desc: Have you ever wondered how things that surround us every day are produced? Find out about the whole process from the beginning to the end in a documentary television series How It's Made. The series demonstrates how various items like clothing and accessories, food, industrial products, cars, musical instruments and many more are manufactured. Who would have thought how exciting it would be to watch a cupcake, formula 1 race car or gummy vitamins being made?

programme.title: How Do They Do It?
programme.desc: As the modern world becomes progressively automated and mechanised it's easy to become detached from how things are made and how they work. The hit series returns to uncover the miraculous feats of engineering which underpin life in the 21st century. How the seemingly mundane are often the result of highly sophisticated engineering and production processes. This fascinating behind-the-scenes journey delves deep into the production of everyday modern items from surfboards to satchels and trombones to cricket bats.

programme.title: Salvage Hunters: The Restorers
programme.desc: Expert craftsmen are bringing Drew Pritchard's finds back to life and restore them to their former glory. Drew hunts for treasures such as derelict gems and forgotten remnants across the country. And then he and his team do the restoration turning trash to gold, so that worn objects become shining gems for which Drew's customers want to pay a lot of money. All kinds of items can and will be restored, starting from a century-old suitcase to an ancient coffee machine, from a ravaged carousel horse to a large railway clock.

programme.title: Filthy Fortunes
programme.desc: The show follows extreme-cleaning specialist Matt Paxton, dubbed the "King of Hoards," as he wades into America's most cluttered homes in search of hidden treasures. Think "American Pickers" meets "Hoarders," with a dash of financial gamble thrown in for good measure.

programme.title: Tiny House Hunters
programme.desc: Reality series showing American house hunters who are considering joining the tiny-house revolution where people are choosing to live in smaller homes - often less than 55 square metres -and praising their benefits. In this property series realtors present three petite houses to prospective buyers. Some of the homes would be used as permanent residences whilst others could be a retreat to escape to. There are various reasons for the trend for tiny-living; some people are doing it for financial reasons, others are trying to live more ecologically and some yearn for a simpler lifestyle. When the potential tiny-homeowners are faced with the practical limitations of the properties on offer will they take the plunge and embrace the joys of tiny living? Or will they change their minds for more spacious accommodation?

programme.title: Overhaulin'
programme.desc: Overhaulin' is an American reality TV series about customizing cars. The main difference from the other shows of this type is detailed presentation of the technical process and import scene plus serious-minded approach to the car owner's needs. The hosts are Chip Foose and Chris Jacobs. The concept of the series is that the car owner is absolutely unaware of what's going on. His car disappears one day and the owner is convinced that it has been stolen, misplaced or lost at a mechanic's shop, or has been towed away by police. Chip Foose and a team of mechanics have a week to remake the car into a custom masterpiece. Each show ends up with the surprise reuniting of the owner and his customized baby on four wheels.

programme.title: G.A.S. Extreme Customs
programme.desc: Join boss Beau Boeckman and the crew from Galpin Auto Services as they resurrect some of the most iconic machines of automotive history and keep the flag flying for car culture. Aided by custom car experts Dave Shuten and 'Mad Mike' Martin, Beau transforms these neglected and decrepit automobiles into objects of beauty and art. Episodes see the team bring to life a unique Pantera that was hot-rodded by Carroll Shelby; beef up a '68 Charger with some up-to-date mechanics; make-over a couple of Hollywood star vehicles built by legendary George Barris; and re-build a '72 Mach-1 Mustang resto-mod for NASCAR superstar Joey Logano.

programme.title: Homestead Rescue
programme.desc: This reality TV show follows Marty Raney and his two children, Matt Raney and Misty Bilodeau, who are successful homesteaders from the state of Alaska and have the skills needed to fish, hunt, raise livestock, and otherwise survive in an untamed landscape. Struggling homesteaders across the country call these experts to help them save their homesteads and become self-sufficient while they teach them the necessary skills to survive the wilderness.

programme.title: Carspotting
programme.desc: Carlos buys a '57 GMC big window truck and finds a buyer who wants it turned into a low-riding hot rod, in a hurry. Bad repairs and a bent chassis make it a huge job, so to offset costs, Carlos buys an oddly decorated '64 Impala as a quick flip.

programme.title: Kindig Customs
programme.desc: Bitchin' Rides is a reality styled TV show hosted by Dave Kindig from the Salt Lake City, Utah-based company Kindig It Designs. Dave's real passion is designing and building custom cars. We watch the process of restoring and rebuilding all types and all periods of cars. In each episode Dave and his team review a car, create a design, then the team takes it apart and rebuilds to create a one-of-a-kind gem. Things get really ugly before they get pretty. Dave has the best team of top mechanics, technicians and fabricators in the business, quality is their only focus when they create the baddest bitchin' rides.

programme.title: How Do They Do It?
programme.desc: How Do They Do It? Ever wondered how the stripes get into toothpaste or how contact lenses are made? How do goods get from one country to another and then into our supermarkets? What are car tires made from and exactly why are plasma TV screens flat? Eating, drinking, driving, flying. These all are activities that we carry out with barely a second thought. But have you ever wondered what exactly goes into your teabag and how it got there? How does an airport handle hundreds of thousands of items of luggage each day? And just how can a car's airbag inflate so quickly? Every day – often without even realizing it – we come into contact with technology, be it in the bathroom, in the car or on the golf course. We take a look at how things work, and focus on some of the most amazing examples of everyday objects including the world's fastest elevator and the most expensive chocolate money can buy.

Sitting in a comfortable chair in your warm apartment just try to imagine how it really is when electricity and running water is not inevitable fact of life. The Kilchers hunt, go fishing, garden, gather, raise livestock in order to survive Alaska's uncontrollable power and wilderness.

Each couple is completely unprepared for what is about to happen when they become parents which is where each set of grandparents comes in handy. Tensions become high as everyone has their own set of rules on what the "perfect" parent should be like and what the future beholds for the young parents to be.

programme.title: Outdaughtered
programme.desc: 40 bottles a day, 420 diapers a week and feedings every three hours became the new normal for Danielle and Adam Busby when they welcomed home the only all-female set of quintuplets in the country. The family of three became a family of eight overnight, and TLC follows that incredible journey in the new series OutDaughtered. The series captures Danielle, Adam and their adorable 4-year-old daughter Blayke as they adjust to their new life, while trying to hold on to the identities and lives they had cultivated before the five new additions arrived. Following the hilarious and heartwarming antics of the entire family including Danielle's zany mother, Michelle, and her older twin sisters and their families, it's all hands on deck as the family relies on their tight-knit circle to make the most out of this incredible lifetime adventure.

programme.title: Doubling Down With the Derricos
programme.desc: Although sleepless nights, sibling squabbles and living rooms full of toe-tripping toys are a regular feature in any home with kids, what really happens when there are 14 of them under one roof? The series features a Las Vegas couple, Karen and Deon, who have had four sets of multiples back to back, with all of them being conceived naturally. The show will showcase the endearing couple who are all set to welcome a set of triplets while raising the elder 11, their ages ranging from 2 to 14. While Karen and Deon both have always wanted to have a big family, a ménage of 14 is not exactly they'd wished for. With both having inherited a gene pool that boasts a lineage of multiple births, the show will portray how the family celebrates and embraces all of life's hurdles and drama with open arms.

programme.title: Say Yes to the Dress
programme.desc: Delves into the heart of world famous Kleinfeld Bridal where the staff face immense pressure to help each bride find the dress if her dreams. Moms, bridesmaids and friends all express their opinions and often frustrate both bride and staff. In the end though, most brides find that "dream dress" and walk down with their grooms into wedded bliss.

programme.title: Kitchen Boss
programme.desc: Hosted by Buddy Valastro, this cooking program takes various Italian-American dishes from Valastro's own family recipes and shows how they can be prepared in minimal time and using ingredients that are easily obtainable and affordable. Each meal usually consists of a main course, a side dish and a dessert and Buddy is joined in the kitchen by members of his family to show us how it's done and to add authenticity. Episodes feature Buddy and his wife Lisa making chicken Sorrentino with fusilli with a side of asparagus and chocolate dipped strawberries for dessert for date night; Auntie Anna revealing her secret recipes for manicotti and her chicken with vinegar peppers; or Buddy and his cousin Frankie reminiscing about the sights and food of Italian street fairs. The recipe for each dish can be found on the show's website.

For some of these couples, the real drama is just starting because they barely know each other and they have to battle critics, doubters, and various obstacles on their road to love. Some of the couples that are featured on the show are Danielle and Mohamed, Melanie and Devar, Loren and Alexei, Kyle and Noon, Brett and Daya and Russ and Paola.

programme.desc: 40 bottles a day, 420 diapers a week and feedings every three hours became the new normal for Danielle and Adam Busby when they welcomed home the only all-female set of quintuplets in the country. The family of three became a family of eight overnight, and TLC follows that incredible journey in the new series OutDaughtered. The series captures Danielle, Adam and their adorable 4-year-old daughter Blayke as they adjust to their new life, while trying to hold on to the identities and lives they had cultivated before the five new additions arrived. Following the hilarious and heartwarming antics of the entire family including Danielle's zany mother, Michelle, and her older twin sisters and their families, it's all hands on deck as the family relies on their tight-knit circle to make the most out of this incredible lifetime adventure.

programme.title: Doubling Down With the Derricos
programme.desc: Although sleepless nights, sibling squabbles and living rooms full of toe-tripping toys are a regular feature in any home with kids, what really happens when there are 14 of them under one roof? The series features a Las Vegas couple, Karen and Deon, who have had four sets of multiples back to back, with all of them being conceived naturally. The show will showcase the endearing couple who are all set to welcome a set of triplets while raising the elder 11, their ages ranging from 2 to 14. While Karen and Deon both have always wanted to have a big family, a ménage of 14 is not exactly they'd wished for. With both having inherited a gene pool that boasts a lineage of multiple births, the show will portray how the family celebrates and embraces all of life's hurdles and drama with open arms.

programme.title: 90 Day Fiancé: Happily Ever After?
programme.desc: American reality series, a follow-up spinoff of ''90 Day Fiancé'' that features couples who have applied for or received a K-1 visa (available uniquely to foreign fiancés of U.S. citizens) and have ninety days to marry each other, follows some of the most famous and interesting couples from the original show and documents the ups and downs of their relationships after they got married. For some of these couples, the real drama is just starting because they barely know each other and they have to battle critics, doubters, and various obstacles on their road to love. Some of the couples that are featured on the show are Danielle and Mohamed, Melanie and Devar, Loren and Alexei, Kyle and Noon, Brett and Daya and Russ and Paola.

programme.title: Say Yes to the Dress
programme.desc: Delves into the heart of world famous Kleinfeld Bridal where the staff face immense pressure to help each bride find the dress if her dreams. Take a peak at the brides as they try on their dream dresses! It brings us up close and into the dressing room as brides prepare for their big day. Moms, bridesmaids and friends all express their opinions and often frustrate both bride and staff. In the end though, most brides find that "dream dress" and walk down with their grooms into wedded bliss.

programme.title: Sister Wives
programme.desc: Kody Brown, with his four wives Meri, Janelle, Robyn and Christine and their combined 17 children, attempt to navigate life as a "normal" family in a society that shuns their lifestyle. From their unconventional family structure and living arrangements to financial challenges, each half hour episode exposes the inner workings of a polygamist household, revealing the unexpectedly tight-knit and loving relationships between Kody's wives. The series also captures the intense dynamics surrounding a man juggling three wives while attempting to keep it a secret from the outside world- but the general public is not the only challenge that the Brown family unit is facing.

programme.title: Cake Boss
programme.desc: Carlo's Bakery in Hoboken New Jersey create elaborate, elegant and interesting edible art cakes. The show explores the intricacy of working with your family, and their interpersonal relationships with other employees. Watch as they create everything from classic wedding cakes to alien spaceships.

After meeting with medical experts, the sisters strive to reach their goal but drama ensues as they struggle to stick to their healthy diets. Will the Slaton sisters stay on the right track and turn their lifestyles around?

Osborne take on some of the most challenging cases of their careers. Patients from all over the world, are looking to get their lives back and these surgeons are their last hope. This intense series highlights unique patients, difficult surgeries, and life-changing procedures.

programme.title: My 3000-lb Family
programme.desc: Cousins Naomi, Drew and Chitoka nearly weigh a combined 2,000 pounds. With the help of Dr. Charles Procter Jr., the desperate cousins attempt to overcome anxieties and live healthier lives, and this series follows their progress. It begins with Naomi's mom, Beverly, undergoing weight-loss surgery, which she hopes will inspire her daughter, niece and nephew to follow her footsteps. Despite seeing the complications involved in her mom's recovery, Naomi is motivated by her dream to start a family. Drew, meanwhile, needs to realize how addictive his eating habits have become, and Chitoka – bed-bound for more than three years – must literally take steps forward before qualifying for surgery.

programme.title: Bad Hair Day

And the battle against illegal fishing continues, this time with a highly valued species of octopus.

A man breaks into a song of gratitude when his two laptops are returned to him. Agents in Denver discover a bag packed with rotting fish and put on their detective hats to hunt for the owner of a jewelry box full of treasures.

programme.title: Inside Airport: Lost & Found
programme.desc: Airport Lost and Found workers reunite travelers with a dog who wiggled out of his leash upon arrival and wandered the airport grounds for a week, a collection of vintage tennis rackets belonging to a pro tennis player, a purse containing over a hundred dollars in cash, a backpack brimming with lifesaving prescription medicine, a child's beloved stuffed panda bear, and a full Army uniform.

programme.title: Ice Road Rescue
programme.desc: "Ice Road Rescue" portrays a group of heroic tow truck rescue workers. When winter hits Norway the transport roads turn into treacherous bobsleigh tracks. Every day the rescuers fight to keep this routes open by rescuing heavy trailers stuck in the mountain terrain. Winter storms, avalanches and lack of daylight through the winter season are just some of the challenges they have to face, working close to the polar circle. Extreme winter conditions that often make them risk their lives. "Ice Road Rescue" shows the ultimate man versus nature.

This series will see Maseratis going 200 mile an hour in Le Mans, an Audi R8 enter the Gymkhana Grid, and a Porsche turned into an ice-rally roadster. Alongside there will be Bentleys in the desert, Jaguars racing Spitfires and even an off-roading transporter carrying a Lamborghini. SuperCar MegaBuild: Even perfection can be perfected!

programme.title: Brain Games
programme.desc: National Geographic Channel's Emmy-nominated series Brain Games returns this summer with 10 new mind-blowing episodes! Host Jason Silva gets inside your head and shows you what's really going on in there with an intricate series of interactive experiments designed to mess with your mind and reveal the inner-workings of your brain. Hailed by critics as "tremendous fun" that "makes science entertaining," Brain Games turns your mind's eye inwards for a fascinating journey into the three and a half pounds of tissue that makes you... you.

programme.title: Brain Games
programme.desc: Scientists have found that optical illusions are one of the best ways to get inside your head to see how your brain works. Through a series of fun, interactive games and illusions we'll play a few tricks on your eyes to show you how your brain builds your reality. You'll learn an easy way to turn beautiful celebrities into ugly monsters using only your mind, and how you can shrink a 6' 4"" man to half his height. Get ready to see why you shouldn't always believe your eyes - on Brain Games.

programme.title: Brain Games
programme.desc: Think youre in charge of your own destiny? Do you believe the decisions you make are rational? Do you consider yourself good at weighing the options? Think again. This episode of Brain Games puts your decision-making process to the ultimate test with a series of fast-paced interactive games, surprising experiments, and a team of experts to prove that the decisions you make every day are not as reliable as you think and how you can you put yourself back in the drivers seat.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Air traffic controllers hear an explosion when Air Algérie Flight 6289 lifts off from a remote desert airport. And moments later, the Boeing 737-200 crashes in the Sahara. An intense fire ravages the fuselage, instantly killing all but one of the 103 people on board. For an international team of investigators, it's clear the left engine exploded after liftoff—and that a fatigue crack eventually explains why. What's less obvious is why the highly-experienced crew of the state-owned national carrier was unable to keep their aircraft in the sky. Single-engine failures are infinitely survivable, and the pilots should have been able to recover by working together. Investigators ultimately find their answer in the CVR and in a toxic tug-of-war between a belligerent captain working at cross purposes with Algeria's first-ever female airline pilot.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Every time a plane crashes, the world takes notice. And so do the experts whose job it is to figure out what happened. Air Crash Investigation uncovers the truth behind the most legendary aviation disasters, and every episode features eyewitness accounts, captivating reenactments, state-of-the-art CGI, and interviews with the investigators who ultimately determined what went wrong. Unraveling the complex mystery is a painstaking process that takes months—and sometimes years—of detective work. The twisted wreckage at the crash site tells part of the story; investigators can use it to learn about the final seconds of a flight and rule out mechanical failures. The flight data and cockpit voice recorders are critical, but they don't always reveal what happened. It almost always takes a tragic combination of factors to bring down an airplane.

programme.title: Car S.O.S.
programme.desc: Car lover Chris has had his beloved, Ferrari engined, 1971 Fiat Dino coupe for nearly 25 years. The former engine mechanic had to put the restoration on hold when he was diagnosed with a rare type of cancer. Now it's up to Tim and Fuzz to get this rusting Dino back to its best. Tim takes a drive in one of the most beautiful cars in the world and Fuzz gets his hands on a Ferrari racing engine for the very first time.

programme.title: Car S.O.S.
programme.desc: Petrol head Tony's Jaguar Mk2 has been in his family for over 40 years. Due to complications following a stomach operations he's not been able to restore the car himself and it's sat neglected in the garage for nearly two decades. With Fuzz battling to start the Jags engine and Tim having to get his hand dirty making parts it will be a race against time to get this British classic finished on time.

programme.title: Ancient Bodies: Secrets Revealed
programme.desc: Human remains are discovered near Croghan Hill, Ireland a place where ancient kings were once crowned. The investigation takes a turn when authorities realize the body is not a current missing person or murder victim, but rather one that is thousands of years old. As archeologists examine the remains, a story unfolds that reveals the gruesome murder of a King by his followers.

programme.title: Ancient Bodies: Secrets Revealed
programme.desc: In the mountains of Northern Italy, a grizzly discovery is made by a couple of mountaineers. In a nearly unreachable part of the world, human remains are found sticking out from a glacier. These remains turn out to be those of the oldest mummified human (ice mummy) ever found. Researchers are shocked by the man's cause of death and realize they are investigating a homicide that is thousands of years old.

programme.title: Yukon Rescue
programme.desc: Avalanche technicians race to repair a remote weather station before an incoming storm. The escalating risks force them to carry out a bombing mission to flush out a dangerous buildup of snow above the Klondike Highway. Meanwhile, Dawson City is left reeling from the loss of the person they rely on the most to keep them safe. In Whitehorse, Ray embarks on a remote, high-stakes rescue mission along a snow-covered back road, only to get stuck himself as daylight dwindles and temperatures plummet.

programme.title: Yukon Rescue
programme.desc: While the spring melt has everyone scrambling to protect Dawson City from the threat of catastrophic flooding, the fire department responds to a mysterious 911 call that puts the entire town in jeopardy. Meanwhile, two volunteer firefighters head out into the vast wilderness, but all their preparation and training are no match for the Yukon's harsh terrain. Later, the Yukon's Civil Air Search and Rescue Association faces treacherous flying conditions in its investigation of a historic missing plane, and Ray gets a call for help that takes him into the Yukon's remote backcountry.

programme.title: Yukon Rescue
programme.desc: The Dawson City Fire Department races to protect the town from devastating flash floods. In Watson Lake, while responding to emergency calls about a rogue bison herd threatening local communities and damaging vehicles, a conservation officer suspects a lone individual deep in the woods of engaging in illegal activity. Near Whitehorse, officers set up a covert sting operation to catch a serial poacher. Meanwhile, Land Guardians from the Kwanlin Dun First Nation launch an urgent investigation into illegal logging and dumping that is threatening to devastate the landscape and wildlife, while Ray and Doug attempt to help a hunter whose vehicle has broken down in the wilderness.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation Special Report
programme.desc: With airplane travel becoming increasingly popular in a shrinking world and millions of passengers journeying this way every day, it is helpful to be aware of the potentail dangers involved. This show presents remarkable stories of some of the most catastrophic accidents in aviation history and investigates the causes of the accidents, what effect they had on the industry and the steps taken to ensure that they don't happen in the future. Each stand-alone episode features compelling re-enactments, expert analysis and interviews with those involved. The explanations for the accidents range from the explosive power of decompression to problems with autopilots and computerised control systems to air traffic control errors.

programme.title: Ancient Bodies: Secrets Revealed
programme.desc: When the human remains of a female are uncovered near Vejle, Denmark, an archeologist begins detailing a fantastic tale of who she was and why she was murdered, linking her to ancient sagas and even King Harald Bluetooth! But as the archeology study evolves, a rival archeologist has another theory on whose body this is and why her death occurred in the first place.

programme.title: To Catch a Smuggler
programme.desc: Even during a pandemic, smuggling never stops. After adjusting tactics in the early days of the COVID crisis to meet the increasing flow of narcotics coming across our southern land borders, the Department of Homeland Security is now pivoting back to our nation's airports where international travel is starting to rev back up again. Whether narco-traffickers try to slip through an airport, seaport or land crossing, vigilant officers are on high-alert to stem the flow of illegal contraband. Using every tool available to them, DHS will stop at nothing to catch a smuggler.

programme.title: To Catch a Smuggler
programme.desc: HSI agents follow a possible meet up between one of their undercover agents and a smuggler delivering large quantities of meth in Atlanta. CBP officers in New York find a female passenger with several balloons of cocaine on her body and inside her vagina. She fails to remove one of them and is taken to a hospital. In Miami, CBP officers have to push for answers from passengers that clearly aren't telling the truth.

programme.title: To Catch a Smuggler
programme.desc: As part of a joint effort during Super Bowl LIV, dubbed "Operation Team Player," CBP and HSI seize more than 176,000 counterfeit items, and make multiple arrests related to human trafficking and drug smuggling. HSI Atlanta conducts a controlled delivery of a hollowed-out truck battery filled with 5 kilos of heroin. And HSI New York tracks a suspected drug courier, a.k.a. "Busy Bee", who is found to have pellets of cocaine concealed on his person.

programme.title: To Catch a Smuggler
programme.desc: CBP Atlanta discovers a suitcase left in the airport by its owner, which contains cocaine concealed in coffee bags. programme.title: UFC. Conor McGregor-Max Holloway
programme.desc: Martial Arts based TV programme. UFC stands for the Ultimate Fighting Championship which is an American mixed martial arts (MMA) promotion company based in Las Vegas that is owned by William Morris Endeavour.The purpose of UFC fighting was to establish the most effective martial art in a contest that had no weight classes and minimal rules that were as follows: no biting, hair pulling, groin shots and eye gouging. Korvpall: EuroLeague. Partizan - Zalgiris Kaunas
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

Suurbritannia linnades filmitud sarjas näeme päris patsiente kriisiolukorras ja meie arstid Chris ning Xand näitavad, kui põnevalt toimib kiirabi ja milleks on meie keha suuteline äärmuslikes olukordades.

programme.title: Adam Richman sööb nagu jalkafänn
programme.desc: Adam Richman on Liverpoolis, et vaadata vägevate Punaste mängu. Kuid enne avavilet jõuab ta nautida fännide armastatud soola-pipra kana, süüa seapeast valmistatud uhket lõunasööki ning lõpetuseks maitsta imehead pirukat, mis on küpsetatud otse Anfieldi kõrval.

programme.title: Kinoteatri MM Katarsis
programme.desc: Kinoteater täidab lüngad jalgpalli mõtestamisel, mis Aet Süvaril, Marek Lemsalul ja Indrek Zelinskil taktikalaua taga kohmitsedes paratamatult sisse jäävad. Henrik Kalmet ja Tõnis Niinemets uurivad, kas teoreetiliselt oleks FIFA-l üldse võimalik olla korruptiivsem Kohtla-Järve linnavalitsusest. Tegevjalgpallureid õpetab sukelduma, nii platsil kui ka pallimängu nüanssidesse Karl-Andreas Kalmet. Mängude tulemusi ennustab kaheksajalg Kait Kall. Režissöör Kristo Veinberg, toimetaja Greta Külvet, produtsendid Age Kraus ja Rivo Saarna.

programme.title: Tõde ja valed
programme.desc: Võitluses tõe eest saab usust relv. Tuhandeid aastaid on religioonid näidanud inimestele elus suunda, pakkunud lootust ja tuge. Aga ikka jälle on usku kasutatud ka poliitilise vahendina. Sõjad ja konfliktid puhkevad religioonide pärast. Tihti on keeruline eristada, mis on tõde ja mis vale.

programme.title: Toiduteadlik
programme.desc: Saatesari jagab inimestega teaduslikult põhjendatud fakte ja nõuandeid, mis aitavad teha teadlikke toiduvalikuid ja kaitsta oma tervist.

programme.title: Koomikud ja küsimused
programme.desc: Kõige lõbusam küsimustesaade teleekraanil! Punkte jagatakse nii õige vastuse kui ka humoorika mõttekäigu eest. Võistkondade kaptenid on stand-up koomikud Sander Õigus ja Mikael Meema, saadet hoiavad kursil Kaspar Kikerpill ning Karl-Alari Varma. Igas saates on ka kaks külalist, kes annavad oma panuse punktide kogumisse. Koomikuid toetavad Synne Valtri ja Reimo Sagor.

programme.title: Psühho
programme.desc: "Vaesusega on see paha lugu, et see võtab kogu sinu aja" - sellisele järeldusele on jõudnud paljud mõtlejad. Igapäevaelu tiirleb tihti ümber viletsa ja ebameeldiva. On see möödapääsmatu ja paratamatu ning mis on selle põhjus ja tagajärg? Saatejuht Märt Treieri külalised on kultuuriloolane Linnar Priimägi, kirjanik Valdur Mikita, psühhiaater Andres Lehtmets, ajakirjanik ja loovterapeut Kadi Jaanisoo-Kuld, kirjanik Pamela Maran, kohtutäitur Risto Sepp.

programme.title: Zuckerberg: metaversumi kuningas
programme.desc: Facebooki 20. aastapäevaks valminud dokumentaalfilm mehest, kelle programmeeritud lehele on loonud konto iga teine maakera elanik. Film selgitab Facebooki ärimudeli arengut ja seda suunavate algoritmide ootamatut väge. Mida arvab Mark Zuckerberg ise süüdistustest, et nõrk kontroll suunatavate algoritmide ja reklaamide üle võimaldab mõjutada valimisi, käivitada ning summutada revolutsioone? Millised sündmused aitasid tal kujuneda üheks 21. sajandi kõige jõukamaks ja mõjuvõimsamaks meheks? Mis tagajärjed on metaversumi endisel kõikvõimsusel meie kõigi privaatsusele ja maailma tulevikule?

programme.title: Ukraina stuudio
programme.desc: Venemaa ja Ukraina korvavad patiseisu rinnetel vastastikuste õhulöökidega. Drooni- ja raketirünnakutega lülitab Kiiev rivist välja Venemaa naftataristut ja logistikakeskusi, Moskva omakorda sihib Ukraina tsiviilobjekte. Venemaa ei saa hakkama droonirünnakute tõrjumisega, Ukrainal omakorda pole piisavalt võimekust ballistiliste rakettide vastu. Sõja dünaamikat analüüsib "Ukraina stuudios" kindralmajor reservis Riho Ühtegi. NATO tippkohtumine Ankaras tõi mitmeid häid uudiseid Ukrainale. Kui kiiresti võib president Donald Trumpi meelemuutustest Kiievile reaalset abi sündida, kuidas vastab sellele Kreml ning milliseks kujuneb Euroopa rinderiikide kaitse uus realiteet, seda selgitab stuudio kaitseminister Hanno Pevkur. Saatejuht on Maria-Ann Rohemäe. Toimetaja Peep Kala, režissöör Rait Roland Veskemaa, produtsent Tiina-Mari Koljak.

programme.title: Rimini
programme.desc: R: Ulrich Seidl. Musta komöödia sugemetega draama. Lembelaulik Richie Bravo (Michael Thomas) elab Itaalia kuurortlinnas Riminis ja teenib leiba juhukontsertidega. Mehe paremad päevad on möödas, ent Richie püüab siiski oma vananeva publikuga flirtida ja kunagist hiilgust uuesti, kas või korraks kogeda. Tulevik näib üha trööstitum, ja tagatipuks ilmub Richie ellu taas ka tütar, kes isalt üksnes raha tahab. Kitsikuses Richiel tuleb astuda drastilisi samme. Seidl on skandaalne režissöör ja piinlikkusest ei tule puudu ka realistikus "Riminis". Kuldkaru nominent Berliini filmifestivalil.

programme.title: Varjude org
programme.desc: Ryani külaskäigud vanglasse on pere täiesti lõhki ajanud, kuid Ryan neist ei loobu. Faisal otsustab lõpuks Joannat aidata, kuid nende salanõu lõpeb hoopis teisiti, kui plaanis oli.

programme.title: Identiteet
programme.desc: Nevada üksikus motellis elavad kümme inimest taipavad õudusega, et nad kõik tapetakse ükshaaval ära.

programme.title: Uus tütar
programme.desc: Üksikisa kolib oma kahe lapsega Lõuna-Carolina maakohta. Seal märkab ta, et tema tütar hakkab aina kummalisemalt käituma.

programme.title: Ellujääja
programme.desc: USA/ Suurbritannia 2015 märul Lavastaja:James McTeigue Osades:Milla Jovovich, Pierce Brosnan, Dylan McDermott Äsja Londonis asuvasse Ameerika Ühendriikide saatkonda lähetatud välisagendi (Milla Jovovich) ülesandeks on takistada terroristidel siseneda USA-ss. See viib naise otse tulejoonele, temast saab sihtmärk ja ta lavastatakse süüdi. Üritades oma nime puhtaks pesta, peab põgenev agent ära hoidma ka vana-aastaõhtuks Times Square'ile kavandatud laiaulatusliku terrorirünnaku.

programme.title: Soojad kehad
programme.desc: Keset zombiepideemiat, mis on vallutanud kogu maailma, kohtub üks veider zombi nimega R inimesest ellujääja Juliega, kellesse ta esimesest silmapilgust armub. R päästab tüdruku kindlasti surmasuust, misläbi Julie märkab, et ta on teistest erinev. Nende kahe vahel hakkab tekkima sõprussuhe ja mida aeg edasi, seda enam hakkab R muutuma aina... inimlikumaks, ja mis kõige veidram - R'i teod hakkavad tasapisi muutma ka teisi zombisid. Lavastaja Jonathan Levine. Osades Nicholas Hoult, Teresa Palmer, John Malkovich.

programme.title: Paranoia
programme.desc: Koduaresti all elav teismeline peategelane hakkab uskuma, et tema naaber on sarimõrvar.

programme.title: Kolm järgmist päeva (2010)
programme.desc: Kahekordse Oscari-võitja Paul Haggise ("Crash") haarav põnevusdraama. Film jutustab Johni (Russel Crowe, "Gladiaator") elust, milles on kõik hästi - tal on kena kodu, armastav naine, toimiv pereeelu. Kuni päevani, mil ta abikaasa Lara (Elizabeth Banks, "40-aastane neitsi") vahistatakse mõrva eest. Naine mõistetakse oma bossi tapmise eest süüdi, kuid Lara väidab, et ei ole mõrva sooritanud. Kuna naine hakkab vanglas psühholoogiliselt murduma ja tal tekivad enesetapumõtteid, ei jää õpetajana leiba teenival Johnil muud üle, kui koostada ülikeerukas põgenemisplaan.

programme.title: Uus tütar
programme.desc: Üksikisa kolib oma kahe lapsega Lõuna-Carolina maakohta. Seal märkab ta, et tema tütar hakkab aina kummalisemalt käituma.

programme.title: Reetur
programme.desc: FBI agent Roy Clayton juhib ohtliku rahvusvahelise vandenõu uurimist. Kõik juhtlõngad viivat tagasi endise USA erioperatsioonide ohvitseri Samir Hornini.

programme.title: Kokkupõrge
programme.desc: Hiidkomeet on teel Maa poole. Katsed seda hävitada või kursilt kallutada on olnud edutud. Inimestel on aasta aega, et valmistuda kokkupõrkeks tükikesega jäisest igavikust.

programme.title: Ellujääja
programme.desc: USA/ Suurbritannia 2015 märul Lavastaja:James McTeigue Osades:Milla Jovovich, Pierce Brosnan, Dylan McDermott Äsja Londonis asuvasse Ameerika Ühendriikide saatkonda lähetatud välisagendi (Milla Jovovich) ülesandeks on takistada terroristidel siseneda USA-ss. See viib naise otse tulejoonele, temast saab sihtmärk ja ta lavastatakse süüdi. Üritades oma nime puhtaks pesta, peab põgenev agent ära hoidma ka vana-aastaõhtuks Times Square'ile kavandatud laiaulatusliku terrorirünnaku.

programme.title: Red - Eriti ohtlikud agendid
programme.desc: USA 2010 märulikomöödia Lavastaja: Robert Schwentke Osades: Helen Mirren, Bruce Willis, John Malkovich, Morgan Freeman Möllukomöödia neljast endisest CIA agendist. Frank (Bruce Willis), Victoria (Helen Mirren), Marvin (John Malkovich) ja Joe (Morgan Freeman) moodustasid kunagi eriagentide supertiimi, kuid nüüd naudivad nad rauget vanaduspuhkust. Ootamatu sündmus sunnib neid aga taas liituma ja päästmaks oma elu ning riigi tulevikku peavad nad korraldama oma karjääri kõige pöörasema erioperatsiooni - murdma sisse CIA peakorterisse ning paljastama ajaloo suurima vandenõu...

programme.title: Adrenaliin
programme.desc: USA 2006 märul Lavastajad: Mark Neveldine ja Brian Taylor Osades: Jason Statham, Efren Ramirez, Amy Smart, Dwight Yoakam Palgamõrvar Chev Chelios (Jason Statham) alustab oma hommikut ootamatu äratusega. Ta vastab oma mobiilile uimasena ja peaaegu liikumatuna ning ta saab teada, et magamise ajal on talle süstitud mürki ja tal on ainult tund aega elada jäänud. Ainus tee peatada mürgil südame töö lõpetamist, on lasta lakkamatult adrenaliinil voolata läbi oma soonte. Kella tiksudes, liigub Chev mööda Los Angelese tänavaid ja saadab kõik huku teele, kes talle ette jäävad. Nimelt peab ta päästma oma tüdruksõbra Eve hädaohust, olema kaks sammu ees oma vaenlastest, kes püüavad mehest lahti saada ja lõpuks peab ta ka leidma vastumürgi, et päästa oma elu.

programme.title: Adrenaliin: Kõrgepinge
programme.desc: Kassahitist põnevusmäruli veelgi rajum järjelugu. Eelmine kord sai palgamõrvar Chev Chelios mürgisüsti, mis ta pikema jututa teise ilma peaks saatma, kui ta oma südamelihast pideva adrenaliinilaksuga ei kostita. Nüüd röövib Hiina mafiooso Chevi peaaegu hävimatu südame ja asendab selle kunstliku, akutoitel stimulaatoriga, mis vajab töökorras püsimiseks regulaarseid elektrilaenguid. Otsustanud oma päris südame tagasi nõutada ning vandudes varganäole tulist kättemaksu, asub irooniline inglise tapamasin pöörasele tagaajamisele Los Angeleses, surmates igaühe, kes talle teele ette peaks jääma.

programme.title: Neetud United
programme.desc: Lugu Brian Clough' vastuolulisest 44-päevasest positsioonist inglise jalgpalliklubi Leeds United treenerina.

programme.title: Telefonihelin 2
programme.desc: Pärast kohtumist Samara-nimelise tüdrukuna kehastunud õudusega otsustab Rachel põgeneda koos pojaga võimalikult kaugele. Kuid neid jälitava luupainaja jaoks ei oma vahema mingit tähtsust.

programme.title: Kuuvalgus
programme.desc: "Kuuvalgus" on ajatu lugu inimsuhetest ja eneseleidmisest. See jälgib Miami karmis naabruskonnas elava mustanahalise noormehe elu lapsepõlvest täiskasvanuks saamiseni ning tema katsumusi maailmas oma koha leidmisel. Murrangulise kinoteosena on "Kuuvalgus" üheaegselt nii elav portree tänapäeva afroameeriklaste elust kui ka sügavalt isiklik lugu isiksusest, perekonnast, sõprusest ja armastusest. Näitlejate imelised esitused annavad lisajõudu Jenkinsi liigutavale kujutusele hetkedest, inimestest ja tundmatutest jõududest, mis teevad meist need, kes oleme.

programme.title: Sügis New Yorgis
programme.desc: Romantiline draama jõukast naistekütist (Richard Gere), kel tekib suhe endast poole noorema kaunitariga (Winona Ryder). Will plaanib Charlotte pärast esimest ühist ööd hüljata, kuid siis avaldab naine talle ehmatava saladuse - ta põeb eluohtlikku vähki. See valus pihtimus annab nende suhtele täiesti ootamatu pöörde.

programme.title: Siidrimaja seadused
programme.desc: Peategelane on terve senise elu veetnud lastekodus ega ole kunagi selle seinte vahel väljas käinud. Soovides maailma avastada, võtab ta vastu õunakorjaja töö, lootes iseennast tundma õppida.

programme.title: Tristan ja Isolde
programme.desc: Film põhineb keskaegsel romantilisel legendil kuningatütar Isolde ja ülla rüütli Tristani ebamaisest armastusest. Tristan ohverdab oma tunded rahu ja ühtsuse nimel.

programme.title: Vabaliikumises
programme.desc: Suurlinnas elav teismeline Ren MacCormac kolib väikelinna, kus on keelustatud rockmuusika ja tantsimine. Nooruki mässumeelne vastuhakk raputab kohalikke.

programme.title: Mesi
programme.desc: Noor New Yorki Harlemi linnaosa tantsijanna unistab muusikavideote koreograafina läbi löömisest. Lõpuks saabub tema võimalus, kuid sellel on hind, mida naine ei ole nõus maksma.

programme.title: Justin Bieber: Ära iial ütle iial
programme.desc: Dokumentaalfilm jälgib Justin Bieberit ja näitab kaadreid tema esinemistelt 2010. aasta turneel.

programme.title: Keelatud tants 2
programme.desc: Mässumeelne tänavatantsija Andie satub elitaarsesse Marylandi kunstikooli. Neiu püüab korraga nii uue kohaga sobituda kui iseendaks jääda.

programme.title: Piinatud geenius
programme.desc: USA 2001 draama Lavastaja: Ron Howard Osades: Russell Crowe, Jennifer Connelly, Ed Harris, Josh Lucas, Adam Goldberg Parima filmi, stsenaariumi, lavastaja ning naiskõrvalosa Oscari võitnud film matemaatik John Nashi värvikast elust. Meeldiva välimuse ja ekstsentrilise olemisega teadlane John Forbes Nash Jr. (Russell Crowe) tegi üsna noores eas avastuse, mis viis ta rahvusvahelise tuntuse lävele ning ühtlasi USA luure vaatevälja. Paraku jäi lõplik erialane läbilöök saavutamata skisofreenia tõttu. Võideldes takistustega, mis on paljusid hävitanud, leidis Nash kõige enam tuge oma armastavalt abikaasalt Alicialt (Jennifer Connelly). Pärast aastatepikkust tragöödiat saabus Nashi tähetund 1994. aastal, mil see elav legend sai oma töö eest Nobeli preemia.

programme.title: Poiss triibulises pidzaamas
programme.desc: Brunol on uues kodus igav ja ta kolab ringi ümberkaudsetes metsades. Ta leiab kummalise aia, mille taga on mustvalgesse pidžaamasse riietatud poiss. Alguse saab ootamatu sõprus.

programme.title: Suur vale
programme.desc: USA 2015 draama/põnevik Lavastaja:Adam McKay Osades:Christian Bale, Steve Carell, Ryan Gosling Pingeline lugu briljantselt nutikate peategelastega avab ahnete ja vastutustundetute finantsmogulite räpased telgitagused tavakodanikule arusaadavas ja üllatavalt humoorikas võtmes. Neli tippu pürgivat outsaiderit näevad ette USA kinnisvaraturu mulli lõhkemise 2000ndate aastate keskpaigas ning otsustavad tõmmata suurpangad liistule rünnates neid nende oma mängus nende endi relvadega. Film jutustab reaalsetest sündmustest, mis vallandasid viimase ülemaailmse majanduskriisi. 5 Oscari nominent: Parim film Parim režissöör - Adam McKay Parim meeskõrvalosa - Christian Bale Parim stsenaarium - Charles Randolph, Adam McKay Parim montaaž - Hank Corwin 4 Kuldgloobuse nominent: Parim film komöödia- või muusikafilmi kategoorias Parim meesnäitleja (komöödia- või muusikafilmis) - Steve Carell Parim meesnäitleja (komöödia- või muusikafilmis) - Christian Bale Parim stsenaarium - Charles Randolph, Adam McKay

programme.title: Ürgne instinkt 2
programme.desc: Catherine Tramell on jälle seadusega pahuksis ja psühhiaater dr Michael Glass saab ülesandeks teha talle eksperthinnang. Glass on Tramellist lummatud ja tõmmatakse võrgutavasse mängu.

programme.title: Ükskord (2007)
programme.desc: Tänapäeva muusikal tänavamuusikust, immigrandist ja ühest sündmusterohkest nädalast Dublinis, kui nad koos kirjutavad, harjutavad ja salvestavad laule, mis jutustavad nende armastusest.

programme.title: Lindmees
programme.desc: 2015. aastal parima filmi Oscari võitnud pigimustades toonides komöödiafilm, mille keskmes on kunagine Hollywoodi superstaar Riggan Thomson (Michael Keaton), kes aastakümnete eest kuhjas kokku kuulsust ja raha filmides, kus ta kehastas kõikvõimsat superkangelast nimega Lindmees, üritab pärast karile jooksnud abielu ja karidele jooksnud karjääri taas kord rambivalgusesse naasta - sedapuhku Broadway lavalaudadel. Esietendusele eelnevatel päevadel ei ole enam kuigi kerge leida asja, mis pole veel kiiva kiskunud ning lisaks teatritüki sünnivaludele peab mees pidevat lahingut oma muljuda saanud egoga ning üritab samal ajal visalt võita tagasi oma perekonda, karjääri ning eneseväärikust...

programme.title: Papsid
programme.desc: Õie väidab Toomasele, et ta pole vahepeal kliinikus käinud. Raivo leiab oma elutoast mao. Kas Petra karistab Marekit valetamise pärast?

programme.title: Kurjuse kannul
programme.desc: FBI kõige kogenumatest uurijatest ning profileerijatest koostatud meeskond lahendab ränki kuritegusid, mis esmapilgul tunduvad väljapääsmatult keerukad. Meeskonna iga liige on oma valdkonna tipp ning üksteist täendades pole ükski kuritegu neile lahendamatu.

programme.title: Kodus ja võõrsil
programme.desc: Fenomenaalselt edukas ja pikaealine Austraalia draamasari ookeani-äärse väikelinna Summer Bay elanike rõõmudest ja muredest, armumistest ja südamete purunemistest. Sarja trumbiks on haaravad ja inimlikult usutavad tegelaskujud, kelle eludega on vaatajal kerge samastuda. Tegelaste galerii on ka piisavalt mitmekesine, et igaüks leiaks endale lemmiku, kellele kaasa elada - siin on nii teismelisi, noori täiskasvanuid kui ka juba küpsesse keskikka jõudnud peategelasi. Lisaboonuseks on Summer Bay igikestev päikesepaiste, mis rõhutab sarja positiivsust ja elurõõmu.

programme.title: Kellele kuulub su süda?
programme.desc: Vicki otsustab oma keerulised suhted Simoniga selgeks rääkida. Josie tunnistab Vickile viimaks üles, et tahab meditsiiniõpingud pooleli jätta. Basti ja Vicki näitavad Josiele Wiesenkirchenit. Georg kahtlustab, et temaga on midagi lahti. Ka Isa on märganud isa hajameelsust.

programme.title: Nutikas Eesti
programme.desc: Elurõõmsas mälumängusaates seigeldakse üle Eesti erinevatel festivalidel ja laatadel, külastatakse randu, hüpatakse sisse mõnda külapoodi ning otsitakse nutikaid inimesi, kellele esitada kuus põnevat mälumängu küsimust, millele äravastamisel ootab inimesi auhind. Muhedad mälumängud ja reportaažid suvisel Eestimaal. Saadet juhib Peeter Võsa ja telgitagustest toimetab auhinnatud saate "Õhtu!" meeskond.

programme.title: Suvereporter
programme.desc: Suvine uudistemagasin liigub sinna, kus Eesti suvi parajasti kõige elavamalt keeb. Saade toob vaatajani päeva olulisemad sündmused, värvikad inimesed ja meeleolukad lood rannast, linnamelust, festivalidelt, külapidudelt, aga ka Meediamaja rõdult. Reporterile omases hoogsas võtmes jõuavad ekraanile värsked uudised, elulised reportaažid, ootamatud kohtumised ja hetked, mis teevad Eesti suve eriliseks. Saatejuhid Jaanus Koort, Simon Suviste ja Tõnis Sarap hoiavad silma peal nii tõsisematel teemadel kui ka suvistel seikadel meil ja mujal maailmas.

programme.title: 15 küsimust
programme.desc: Kodumaine strateegiline mälumäng, kus mängijal on võimalus hakata panustama enda tugevustele ning samal ajal vastase nõrkusele. Mängu teeb eriliseks see, et osalejad ei pea kunagi kartma, et nad ei tea vastust ühelegi küsimusele, kuna põnev vihjete süsteem välistab selle võimaluse. Kaasakiskuvat ja huvitavat stuudio mälumängu juhib Jüri Butšakov.

programme.title: Roaldi retked
programme.desc: Aafrikat tuntakse maailma moetööstuse prügimäena, kuhu kogu globaalselt üle jääv masstoodang lihtsalt "eest ära" saadetakse. Eesti moedisaineri Reet Ausi missiooniks on aga jätkusuutlik mood, mis tähendab just masstootmisest ülejäävate kangaste tagasi ringlusesse suunamist. Roald Johannson lendab sedapuhku Keenia pealinna Nairobisse, kus Reet on jätkamas oma põnevat seiklust moetööstuse varjatud külgedega võitlemisel.

programme.title: Katie Fforde - Osa sinust
programme.desc: Raamatupidajast Vivien saab ootamatult teate, et talle on neeru siirdamiseks sobilik doonor leitud. Viimasel hetkel otsustab doonor siiski keelduda. Vivien ei lepi tekkinud olukorraga ja otsustab välja uurida, kes see anonüümne doonor on ja miks ta ikkagi otsustas alt hüpata. Salapäraseks meheks osutub edukas kirjanik Thomas, kellega Vivien muutub lähedasemaks kui ta ise sooviks. Viimaks saab ka Thomas teada põhjuse, miks naine ta tegelikult üles otsis.

programme.title: Kuuuurija
programme.desc: Julge ja kompromissitu Kuuuurija kajastab keerulisi ning tundlikke teemasid, millel on suur sotsiaalne ja ühiskondlik mõju. Saatejuht Katrin Lust avab Eesti elu varjatuima poole süvenedes probleemidesse ja inimeste muredesse üle Eesti. Seekord on saates lugu, kuidas üks suurpere elas üürimajas, milles vohas ohtlik hallitusseen. Üürile andja selles kõiges probleemi ei näinud. Saate teises pooles räägime ühest perekonnast, kes kolis maale, et nautida rahulikku elu kuid tüli kohaliku omavalitsuse ja naabritega on keeranud elu maal peaaegu põrguks.

programme.title: Kaks Kanget Kagu-Aasias
programme.desc: Kaks kanget peatuvad Hua Hin'is, mis oli veel sada aastat tagasi vaikne kaluriküla. Tänaseks on sellest saanud pulbitsev kuurortlinn, kuhu armastavad nädalavahetuseks sõita Bangkokis elavad tailased. Kaks kanget võtavad julguse kokku ja sisenevad massaažisalongi.

programme.title: 100 erilist eestlast
programme.desc: Saatejuht Leho Lehis paneb oma graatsilisuse ja painduvuse proovile ja katsetab postitantsu ning uurib selle võluva ja seksika tegevusala telgitaguseid. Veel tutvustame teadaolevalt ainsat trikikorvpallurit Eestis.

programme.title: Naabriplika
programme.desc: Vallavanemal tekib sohipoja ilmsiks tuleku tõttu suur kodutüli ja lahutus pole kaugel. Kröösman ei taha vangi minna ja põgeneb. Varik saab valusalt korvi ja süda puruneb kildudeks. Kirikuõpetaja otsustab minna rahva sekka, et patustele lunastust pakkuda ja seab üles pihitelgi. Pärast raputavaid sündmusi selgub, et kõik inimesed on südames head. Isegi Esnas.

programme.title: Küladetektiivid
programme.desc: Iga-argipäevane kogupere detektiivisari kahest vastandlikust kriminaalpolitseinikust, kes uurivad maalilises baieri väikeasulas Rosenheimis põnevaid kuritegusid. Kõhukas komissar Korbinian elab õega talus ja lahendaks meeleldi kuritegusid otse traktoriroolist mobiiltelefoni teel - see on ainus tehniline vidin, mida ta on valmis tunnistama. Temast poole noorem, suurlinnast Rosenheimi tulnud komissar Ulrich on aga hea väljanägemisega, armastab kiireid autosid ja on tõeline arvutifriik.

programme.title: Lena Lorenz
programme.desc: Vinz võttis Lena soovi tõsiselt ja otsustas kinkida kogudusele metsasiilu, millest saaks metsakalmistu. Franz valmistub sõitma oma veskit vaatama ja arutab Bastiga Almwirti müümist. Julia viib Lena mägedesse Quirini hukkumiskohta. Tänu Vinzile on Lenal viimaks koht, kuhu Quirini tuhk matta. Claudia kaalub Ameerikasse kolimist, et saada seal kolmas laps, kes kindlalt päästaks Ronja.

programme.title: Proua Fazilet ja tema tütred
programme.desc: Fazilet mõtleb välja uue plaani, kuidas Yasemini hirmutada. Kui ta näeb Selinit abi palumas, viib ta naise haiglasse, kus selgub traagiline tõde, et Selin kaotab lapse. Fazilet on aga sunnitud juhtunust vaikima. Selin naaseb taastuma häärberisse, kuigi ta lähedased ei tea veel, et ta polegi enam lapseootel. Yagiz ja Sinan arutavad Kerime salapärast kohalolekut. Häärberisse saabub uus töötaja Sevda.

programme.title: Kellele kuulub su süda?
programme.desc: Kui Vicki ja Simon saavad pärast suhete selgeks rääkimist väga hästi läbi, näevad sõbrad neis uut unelmate paari. Josie soovitab tal Hannes unustada ja lubadagi endal uuesti armuda. Simon saab ootamatu telefonikõne, mis teda sügavalt vapustab. Isa ja Fabian muretsevad oma isa pärast. Resi ja Anne-Marie lähevad aaret otsima, aga hoopis Bruno leiab midagi.

programme.title: Kuldvillak
programme.desc: Eesti armastatuim mälumäng pakub põnevat kaasaelamist ja võimalust ka kodus kaasa nuputada. Saatejuht on Eeva Esse-Sõõrumaa.

programme.title: Suvereporter
programme.desc: Suvine uudistemagasin liigub sinna, kus Eesti suvi parajasti kõige elavamalt keeb. Saade toob vaatajani päeva olulisemad sündmused, värvikad inimesed ja meeleolukad lood rannast, linnamelust, festivalidelt, külapidudelt, aga ka Meediamaja rõdult. Reporterile omases hoogsas võtmes jõuavad ekraanile värsked uudised, elulised reportaažid, ootamatud kohtumised ja hetked, mis teevad Eesti suve eriliseks. Saatejuhid Jaanus Koort, Simon Suviste ja Tõnis Sarap hoiavad silma peal nii tõsisematel teemadel kui ka suvistel seikadel meil ja mujal maailmas.

programme.title: 15 küsimust
programme.desc: Kodumaine strateegiline mälumäng, kus mängijal on võimalus hakata panustama enda tugevustele ning samal ajal vastase nõrkusele. Mängu teeb eriliseks see, et osalejad ei pea kunagi kartma, et nad ei tea vastust ühelegi küsimusele, kuna põnev vihjete süsteem välistab selle võimaluse. Kaasakiskuvat ja huvitavat stuudio mälumängu juhib Jüri Butšakov.

programme.title: Öökülaline
programme.desc: Kui mitu tundi on Kristjan Järvi ööpäevas, et ta nii palju jõuab? Tema nakatav energia ja pöörased ideed on tuntud ka Eestist kaugemal, aga oma südames hoiab ta esikohal just Eestimaad. Kristjan armastab üle kõige "Komeedi" kommi ning alustab oma hommikuid ühe väga erilise "joogiga". Isa Neeme Järvi 88ndaks sünnipäevaks valmib ka tema esimene omatehtud skulptuur. Kirev ja ootamatuid pöördeid pakkuv "Öökülaline" viib televaatajad Vääna-Jõesuust Laitsesse ning Tehnopoli robotite laborist Tallinna Lauluväljakule. Saatejuht: Mart Normet, operator: Kullar Viimne, heli: Tanel Paats, toimetajad: Kairit Tsäro-Mirme ja Sigrid Salutee, režissöör: Andreas Lenk.

programme.title: Papsid
programme.desc: Marika otsustab lapsed mao eest ööseks Aleksi juurde viia. Petra avastab, et Mareki lisatasu pole jõudnud tema pangakontole. Raivo ja Toomas ei leia kuskilt madu, samuti kaob müstiliselt Sassu.

programme.title: Krimi
programme.desc: Eesti staažikaim politseisaade toob vaatajateni olulisemad krimiuudised. Uudiseid elu pahupoolelt vahendab saatejuht Taavi Otsus.

programme.title: Kuum jälg
programme.desc: Aasta 1993, üks Eesti väikelinn. Kirikuõpetaja leitakse hommikul kiriku põrandalt, tema pea on haamriga sisse löödud ja käärkambrist on kadunud hoiukarp. Kuritöö motiiv näib selge olevat - röövmõrv. Uurijad satuvad kohe poliitilise surve alla tapmine kiiresti lahendada. Üsna pea selgub ka võimalik kahtlusalune. Ometi tunneb kogenud uurija Karl Künnap, et see lugu on keerulisem ning röövmõrv võib olla lavastus millegi varjamiseks.

programme.title: CSI: Vegas
programme.desc: Las Vegases on halloween ja sellele kohaselt saab CSI meeskond ülesandeks lahendada kummitusmajast leitud päris laiba müsteerium. Catherine palub Folsomilt abi oma kadunud sõbra otsimisel.

programme.title: Viimane võmm
programme.desc: Markus Rausmani tütar Paula saab liiklusõnnetuses raskelt vigastada ning paar päeva hiljem tapetakse tema ravimifirmas teadurina töötav naine. Anders Prikk on Indias täiendkoolitusel, Miku "paarimeheks" määrab uus ülemus Tanja Murrik Tamara Ridbeki. Vaatamata särisevale energiale Miku ja Tamara vahel, uuritakse välja, et mõrva põhjuseks pole sugugi ravimifirma suured rahad, nagu esiotsa arvati, vaid hoopis isiklikumat laadi asjaolud. Jaoskonnas viiakse läbi tervisekontroll ja seda teostab seni ainult surnute "terviseprobleemidega" tegelnud Mõisnik. Kontrolli käigus selgub, et üks inimene on kanepit tõmmanud.

programme.title: Küladetektiivid
programme.desc: Iga-argipäevane kogupere detektiivisari kahest vastandlikust kriminaalpolitseinikust, kes uurivad maalilises baieri väikeasulas Rosenheimis põnevaid kuritegusid.
